SELECT a.id, TO_CHAR(a.performed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "at",
-- ① 보고자 실명 매핑 COALESCE( (SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = CAST(a.new_values ->> 'input_user_id' AS INT)), '담당자' ) AS "reporter",
-- ② 최종 결재 승인권자 실명 매핑 COALESCE( (SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = CAST(a.new_values ->> 'approver_user_id' AS INT)), '최종 승인자' ) AS "approver",
'최종승인확정' AS "action", COALESCE( (SELECT title FROM esg_indicators WHERE id = CAST(a.new_values ->> 'indicator_id' AS INT)), '미식별 지표' ) AS "target", CONCAT( '[', COALESCE((SELECT facility_name FROM company_facilities WHERE id = CAST(a.new_values ->> 'facility_id' AS INT)), '본사공통'), '] ', a.new_values ->> 'reporting_year', '년 ',
/* 💡 [정합성 마감] 자바 이넘 대문자 문자열 명세와 100% 매칭되도록 TRIM 및 UPPER 안전 가공 */ CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.new_values ->> 'period_type')) = 'YEARLY' THEN '연간' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.new_values ->> 'period_type')) = 'QUARTERLY' THEN CONCAT(a.new_values ->> 'period_value', '분기') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(a.new_values ->> 'period_type')) = 'HALFYEARLY' THEN CONCAT(a.new_values ->> 'period_value', '반기') ELSE CONCAT(a.new_values ->> 'period_value', '월') END, ' 실적 최종 공시 확정 (확정 수치: ', a.new_values ->> 'numerical_value', ')' ) AS "detail" FROM audit_logs a WHERE a.table_name = 'esg_metric_data' AND (a.new_values ->> 'status') = 'APPROVED' AND (a.new_values ->> 'approver_user_id') IS NOT NULL AND a.old_values IS NOT NULL AND (a.old_values ->> 'status') IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVED' ORDER BY a.performed_at DESC
